# ClipBuilder synthetic fixture catalog

These files describe source-controlled, synthetic test cases only. Application
code does not import this directory. Backend tests apply the catalog cases to
the contract-validated sample fixture and assert content-free rule IDs.

The real sample video, poster, generated visual binaries, provider payloads,
and private rights evidence do not belong here. New fixture revisions are added
with new keys; an approved deployed sample is never replaced in place.
